verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer building blocks: built-in pipeline metrics, audio recording, transcript collection via turn events, and the Whisker frame debugger. None of these is a ready-made analytics dashboard for call success rates, durations, outcomes, or sentiment. No Pipecat Cloud analytics dashboard is documented, so a founder would have to build this themselves.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see call analytics — success rates, durations, outcomes, sentiment — in dashboards without building my own
